notices.title: PoH v3 Blake3 @ height 485000 — update workers NOW
notices.body: Blake3 PoH activates at height 485000 (rc17.4; was 500000). Work = Blake3(prev_hash || miner_address || nonce_le) % M == 0. After activation, reported GH/s will drop by ~100–200× vs algebraic v1 (crypto hash vs multiply) and pool M will retarget down — this is expected. Rebuild/redeploy workerpoh (+ CUDA toolkit ≥12.8 on RTX 50). Lab override: HACKME_POH_V3_ACTIVATION_HEIGHT.

notices.title: Pseudo-shares (stats / soft attempt-pay)
notices.body: Public pool accepts share_nonces: each share is a PoH nonce with work % (M/1024) == 0, verified by the coordinator. Soft mode (default) always attempt-pays — shares are for stats and share-rate checks only (SHARE_RATE_REJECT off until GPU full-batch harvest). SHARE_STRICT=1 later enables share-pay. Updated workerpoh harvests shares automatically.

notices.title: Attempt-pay sampled recheck
notices.body: On the soft attempt-pay path, the coordinator samples ~1% of found=false submits and rejects missed_found_unreported if the lease prefix contains a valid PoH hit you did not report.
